name: capture.event.observed
description: A harness-emitted extension event line was observed on a transcript (e.g. OATS type:"event" lines from momOS — delegation.spawned, session.titled, session.archived, context.compacted, memory.folded, plan/todo updates). Published by the watcher (ingress/watcher) for adapters implementing EventExtractor. Stored durably in the Ledger for cross-referencing (delegation.spawned links a manager session to the worker session it spawned); not folded into the markdown vault.
